records.reason: The actual bound figure shows the circle touching the two long horizontal sides and leaving gaps to the two vertical sides. The depicted rectangle width is therefore its diameter 2*5=10. The supplied 2:1 length-to-width ratio gives length 20, so its area is 200, E. A circle strictly inscribed against all four rectangle sides would force equal sides, contradicting 2:1; the image resolves the intended two-side tangency reading. The existing wording flag correctly records this qualification. Preserve normal E grading and the exact current rectangle-area/radius-diameter/ratio mapping; a retained interpretive limitation does not make the accepted numerical mapping structurally wrong.
